description: Proves a capability was minted exactly once from a confirmed payment

judges.description: TRUE if xmr_payment_received receipt exists with Actuality=TRUE
TRUE if this invoice has not already minted a capability (no double-credit)

critical_rules: Each invoice can mint its entitlement exactly once
Partial payment does not become paid
Wrong invoice cannot fund another session
Overpayment must be handled deterministically (credit exact amount, not overage)
Authority grant is required to mint (prevents unauthorized capability creation)
